parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes Tier-1 universal exposures: national binary passport/entry screening with discrepancy refusal and possible permanent fraud ineligibility, and a state facility ban in government buildings including airports, parks, schools and colleges, enforced by trespass arrest (one documented arrest, 60-day maximum, 24h in men's ward). If detained, documented national custody harms include birth-sex placement, hormone withdrawal/conversion practices, and immigration-custody forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse. No execution or routine imprisonment for presence, private businesses are outside the state ban, and functioning courts have blocked/enjoined several measures, secured release, and partially enforce protections in cities covering ~55% of population. That working-but-incomplete recourse lifts this above organised-targeting/no-remedy tiers, while universal facility/document exposure keeps it well below Reduced Risk.

entry_documents.exposure: National binary sex definition; X/mismatched passports stopped for new issue, existing X valid to expiry; entry cable directs refusal on document discrepancy/doubt and consideration of permanent fraud ineligibility for wilful misrepresentation; passports confiscated/blocked reported.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid; fraud finding requires four elements, never automatic, limited waivers; passport policy challenged by civil-liberties suit, still in national courts.
entry_documents.interaction: Foreign visitor's home passport may still trigger secondary screening where presentation/documents diverge, leading from entry refusal to detention/custody exposures.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: National corrections policy from 2026: hair cutting, hormone removal, psychiatric substitution; immigration custody reports of forced labour, beatings, solitary and severe sexual abuse; arrested student held in men's ward.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Several executive orders blocked/enjoined; courts and legal aid exist, but no documented remedy reversing custody practices; corrections bureau stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document/facility encounter can become trespass, detention, then birth-sex placement and care denial - the final operative interaction is materially harsher than the initial charge suggests.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: State 2023 statute bars gender-identity-congruent restrooms/changing facilities in government-owned/leased buildings including airports, parks, schools, universities, prisons; refusal to depart after authority order can be criminal trespass; colleges may fire staff, private colleges evict/include housing restriction.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Private businesses outside state scope; offence requires willful entry plus refusal to depart, with exemptions; one prosecution dismissed June 2025 on standing, statute never substantively tested.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: National government-facility binary rule plus state ban cover overlapping public spaces; private-sector access does not cancel airport/government/hospital exposure.

care_services.exposure: State: minors barred from blockers/hormones/surgeries, 24h waiting period and physician-only/insurance barriers for adults, conscience refusal law; national orders target minor care and funding, DOJ subpoenaed hospital records.
care_services.protection: National judge permanently blocked minor/adult care-ban provisions June 2024 (appeal status unresolved); preliminary injunction earlier; adult care not shown banned outright.
care_services.interaction: Visitor needing hormone continuity faces state physician/insurance barriers and national funding hostility, but current judicial block makes outright denial uncertain rather than documented as operative.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Official framing treats gender identity as fraud/deception and, in 2025-26 national guidance/strategy, links 'radical gender ideology'/'radically pro-transgender' actors to extremism; sports, school and document rules treat assigned sex as determinative.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 2020 employment ruling still cited by state human-relations commission; several orders enjoined; counterterrorism text says powers not for mere disagreement.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Threat-framing increases police/officer discretion at borders, facilities and schools, even where prosecutions are rare.

minors_guardians.exposure: State school facility ban, minor care ban, sports exclusion; national order directs investigation/prosecution of teachers facilitating social transition; 2023 laws allow custody modification based on receiving/might receive care and nullify out-of-state custody in such cases.
minors_guardians.protection: Care-ban provisions permanently blocked June 2024, appeal unresolved; short-term visitor has no documented case of custody loss for mere travel.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling parent/guardian of a trans minor faces school/facility exclusion and a documented legal theory for custody challenge if care is sought, distinct from adult-only risks.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime law covers sexual orientation not gender identity; no state employment/housing gender-identity statute; 3.7 trans women murdered per 100k/year cited with flat law-violence correlation and no background rate in dossier, so treated as undocumented magnitude.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime coverage, human-relations commission enforcing merged employment/housing/public-accommodation claims, local ordinances in counties/cities ~55% of population.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Police are enforcers of facility/document rules in one context and potential protectors in another; local protections stop at state line and do not bind state facilities/border.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport suit unresolved; facility statute untested on merits; care-ban appeal unknown; DL/birth-certificate litigation not sourced; airport application of facility law not documented; 2023 travel advisories not shown reissued/withdrawn.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Documented functioning courts: injunctions, permanent block, dismissal of trespass case, legal-aid FAQ, local ordinances - remedies sometimes work, not merely paper.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Uncertainty is itself exposure for a short-stay visitor who cannot litigate before departure, but documented judicial checks prevent rating as no-recourse.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: routine stops, humiliation, fines/detention without routine imprisonment, deferential outcomes. This case is similar or slightly safer because courts have actually blocked measures and private businesses are outside the ban, but harsher on custody harms and permanent fraud eligibility.

Similar on birth-sex custody placement and documented assault risk in detention, but higher than 0.25-C because here injunctions, dismissal, local protections and a hate-crime statute show remedies sometimes operate, and no weekly raids/extortion pattern is documented.

Lower than 0.55-B: that anchor is mainly administrative secondary screening/delay; here facility use is criminal trespass with an actual arrest, passport discrepancy can support permanent ineligibility, and custody abuse is documented, moving exposure from friction to Tier-1 plus severe custody risk.

parsed.synthesis: The traveller encounters one system: binary national documents/entry screening, state criminal facility exclusion in public buildings, and birth-sex custody if detained interact to turn a document or restroom encounter into detention, care withdrawal and placement harms. State law adds DL fraud treatment and minor-care/custody threats beyond the national framework. Mitigations are real but partial - private facilities open, existing X passports valid, courts have blocked several orders and dismissed the sole trespass prosecution, and local protections cover much of the population - yet none cancels the government-facility, border or custody exposures. That combination sits at the top of High Risk, below Elevated Risk, because outcomes after outing are serious and sometimes custodial, not speculative.
